title: Dataset designer: picking the base object on a new dataset clears the seed's `count` measure — `objectChangePatch` resets `measures: []` on the first pick, so a created dataset saves with no measures
body:
Filing gate ①: an out-of-scope finding from the os-dev on objectui#12810 (PR #12847), class a. The seat confirmed the mechanism by reading `main`. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

## What happens

A new dataset starts from the spec create seed, which carries one structural default measure, `{ name: 'count', aggregate: 'count' }`. The normal create flow is: open a new dataset, pick a base object, save. Picking the base object empties `measures`, so the saved dataset carries `measures: []` and the seed's `count` measure is lost.

**reach:** the dataset designer in create mode. The os-dev drove it through the real `MetadataResourceEditPage` and the real `DatasetDefaultInspector` over a recording in-memory server (jsdom, not a live backend): the first base-object pick sent a `PUT` body with `measures: []`, and the page test read `expected [] to deeply equal [ { name: count, aggregate: count } ]`.

## Mechanism (read on objectui `main`)

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx`, `objectChangePatch` (about `:368`):

```ts
if (next === current) return { object: next };
return { object: next, include: [], dimensions: [], measures: [], filter: undefined };
```

Changing the base object resets the object-dependent keys. That is right when the author moves an existing dataset to another object, because its dimensions and field measures name the old object's fields. It also fires on the FIRST pick, from the empty value of a new dataset, and it clears `measures` even when the only measure is the object-independent `count`. `buildCreateModeBody` keeps the seed's `measures` only when the draft has no `measures` key, so the reset's `[]` wins.

## Expected

- On a new dataset's first base-object pick (empty → an object), the seed's structural defaults survive. In particular, the `count` measure stays.
- Moving an existing dataset from one object to another still clears what names the old object's fields. Whether an object-independent `count` measure should survive that move too is for the claimant to measure and state.
- A test pins: the first pick keeps `count`; CONTROL: changing object A → B still clears field-bound dimensions and measures.

Who acts: a `domain:ui` objectui developer, on `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx` and its tests. Land after objectui#12810 (PR #12847), which changes `createBody.ts` beside it.

Dedupe (MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed): "dataset designer picking base object clears measures objectChangePatch count measure dropped" returned 2 hits, objectui#11417 (chart series) and objectui#11402 (`field: ''` seeding, closed). Neither covers this.

Dedupe words: dataset create count measure dropped, objectChangePatch measures reset, dataset seed measures empty, base object pick clears measures.
